instructions: 检查项目登录实现并参考知识库。

content.text: 查找src中的登录代码，并查询知识库中的登录实现约定。

tools.name: kb
tools.description: 示例知识库服务，并非Codex固定内置工具

tools.name: exec
tools.description: 通过JavaScript编排已启用的工具；示例中可调用tools.exec_command和tools.kb__search

format.definition:
start: pragma_source | plain_source
pragma_source: PRAGMA_LINE NEWLINE SOURCE
plain_source: SOURCE
PRAGMA_LINE: /[ \t]*\/\/ @exec:[^\r\n]*/
NEWLINE: /\r?\n/
SOURCE: /[\s\S]+/

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: 接收补丁文本修改文件

format.definition:
start: begin_patch hunk+ end_patch
begin_patch: "*** Begin Patch" LF
end_patch: "*** End Patch" LF?

hunk: add_hunk | delete_hunk | update_hunk
add_hunk: "*** Add File: " filename LF add_line+
delete_hunk: "*** Delete File: " filename LF
update_hunk: "*** Update File: " filename LF change_move? change?

filename: /(.+)/
add_line: "+" /(.*)/ LF -> line

change_move: "*** Move to: " filename LF
change: (change_context | change_line)+ eof_line?
change_context: ("@@" | "@@ " /(.+)/) LF
change_line: ("+" | "-" | " ") /(.*)/ LF
eof_line: "*** End of File" LF

%import common.LF

tools.description: 发现可用工具；本例使用缩减参数
